Welcome to Fundu.

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of Fundu, including creating, publishing, viewing, sharing and supporting fundraising campaigns. By creating an account, publishing a campaign, or otherwise using Fundu in a way that requires acceptance of these Terms, you agree to them. Please read them carefully.
#### The short version (summary box)

- **Support goes directly to the organizer.** Fundu provides fundraising pages and tools. Supporters send money directly to the receiving methods organizers select. Fundu doesn’t currently receive or hold contributions.
- **Organizers are responsible for their campaigns.** Including the accuracy of stories, claims, receiving information, photos, videos and updates.
- **Totals may be organizer-reported.** Where an organizer enters or updates the amount raised, it hasn’t been independently verified by Fundu.
- **Fundu charges for hosting.** Not a percentage of what supporters send. Promotions may reduce or waive hosting charges, subject to their conditions.
This summary is provided to make these Terms easier to understand. The complete Terms below govern your use of Fundu.
#### 1. Accepting these Terms
These Terms apply whenever you use Fundu.
You must be at least 18 years old to create a Fundu account or organize a campaign. A person under 18 may be the beneficiary of a campaign created and managed by an eligible adult.

Where Fundu asks you to actively accept these Terms, such as when you publish a campaign, we may record your acceptance electronically. This record may include the version of the Terms you accepted, the date and time you accepted them, and the account associated with your acceptance.
#### 2. What Fundu does
Fundu provides technology that lets organizers create, host and share fundraising pages. Fundu provides the campaign page and related fundraising tools.

Unless Fundu expressly introduces a different payment service in the future, money sent to support a campaign goes directly from the supporter to the receiving method selected by the organizer. Fundu does not currently take possession or control of campaign contributions.
Fundu is not the campaign organizer or the campaign beneficiary. Fundu is not a bank, an escrow provider or an investment platform.
Fundu does not guarantee:
- that a campaign will achieve its goal
- that every campaign statement is accurate
- that an organizer will use funds exactly as described
- that supporters will recover money after making a direct transfer
Fundu remains responsible for operating its own platform in accordance with these Terms and applicable law.
#### 3. Accounts and account security
You must provide reasonably accurate account information and keep it up to date. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account.
You must not:
- improperly share your sign-in details
- attempt to access another person’s account
- provide Fundu with banking passwords, mobile-money PINs, wallet passwords, card PINs or passwords for other payment services
- provide one-time codes (OTPs), except through a legitimate sign-in or verification process that specifically requires one
If you reasonably believe your account has been compromised, please tell us promptly at funduhelp@gmail.com.
#### 4. Creating a campaign
Organizers are responsible for the information they publish. Campaign information must not be deliberately false or materially misleading. This includes the campaign’s:
- title and story
- fundraising purpose
- beneficiary information
- goal
- images, videos and updates
- receiving information
- organizer-reported fundraising totals
If you raise money for another person, organization, project or cause, you must have appropriate authority or permission to do so. You must not impersonate another person or organization.
#### 5. Receiving methods and payment information

Organizers may add supported receiving methods so that supporters can send money to them directly. Depending on the functionality available through Fundu, receiving information may include bank account information or other supported receiving methods.
You are responsible for making sure that:
- your receiving information is correct
- you own or control the receiving destination, or are properly authorized to use it
- you are legally permitted to receive funds through it

Receiving information you select for a campaign may be displayed to people who can view that campaign. Only provide receiving information you are comfortable making available to the campaign’s intended audience.
Fundu will not ask for your banking password, mobile-money PIN, wallet password or similar secret credentials merely to display a receiving method.
Fundu does not currently verify every receiving method. If Fundu later verifies particular receiving methods, it will clearly identify what has been verified.
#### 6. Public and private campaigns
Public campaigns may appear in Fundu’s public discovery surfaces, including Explore.
Private (unlisted) campaigns are excluded from public discovery, but may still be accessed by anyone who has the campaign link.

**Private or unlisted does not mean confidential.** Anyone with access to the link may be able to view and share the campaign. Do not publish information you would not want the campaign’s intended audience to see.
#### 7. Supporting a campaign
Supporters are responsible for deciding whether to support a campaign. Before transferring money, please review the campaign information and the receiving information.
Unless Fundu expressly provides a Fundu-operated payment feature in the future, support is sent directly to the organizer’s selected receiving method.

A direct transfer does not mean Fundu has verified the organizer, every statement in the campaign, the receiving destination, or how the funds will ultimately be used. If Fundu later introduces verification, verified elements will be clearly identified.
#### 8. Fundraising totals

Campaign organizers may manually record or update the amounts they have received. Where Fundu displays an organizer-reported amount, it should not be read as Fundu independently confirming that the amount was actually received.
Fundu may introduce ways to verify certain contributions or information in the future. If it does, verified information and organizer-reported information will be clearly distinguished.
#### 9. Direct transfers, refunds and disputes
Because campaign contributions currently go directly from supporters to organizers without Fundu taking possession of the money, Fundu cannot itself reverse or refund those transfers.
If you want a direct transfer returned, you may need to contact, as applicable:
- the organizer
- your bank
- your mobile-money provider
- your wallet or payment provider
- another relevant receiving or payment provider

Fundu may still receive reports, investigate misuse of the platform, restrict campaigns or accounts, preserve relevant records, cooperate with appropriate lawful requests, and take other appropriate platform-level action.
This section concerns campaign contributions. Hosting fees paid to Fundu are separate and are covered in section 10.
#### 10. Hosting fees, cancellations and promotions
Fundu may charge organizers for hosting campaigns or for other clearly identified Fundu services. Before charging you, Fundu will display the applicable price and material purchase information.
The current standard hosting price is ₦100 per hosting day. Organizers pay for the number of hosting days selected for their campaign.
Hosting fees for hosting that Fundu has already provided are generally non-refundable, except where required by applicable law or where Fundu fails to provide the purchased service.

Where you have paid in advance for hosting that has not yet been provided, cancellation and any applicable refund will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the cancellation terms presented at the time of purchase.

Fundu may offer promotional codes, discounts, free periods or other promotional offers. Promotions may be subject to eligibility requirements, availability, duration and other conditions communicated with the promotion. Promotions do not permanently change Fundu’s standard pricing unless Fundu expressly says so.
#### 11. Campaign content and intellectual property

You keep ownership of content you own. You must have appropriate rights or permission to upload content that belongs to someone else, including text, photographs, videos, graphics, logos and other campaign materials.

By uploading campaign content, you grant Fundu a limited, non-exclusive licence to host, store, reproduce, resize, format, display and distribute that content only as reasonably necessary to operate Fundu, display your campaign, allow it to be shared, and provide Fundu’s services. Uploading content does not transfer ownership of it to Fundu.
If you believe content on Fundu unlawfully infringes your rights, please contact us at funduhelp@gmail.com.
#### 12. Prohibited campaigns and misuse
You must not use Fundu for:
- fraud or scams
- deliberately false or materially misleading campaigns
- impersonation
- unlawful activity, including receiving or moving the proceeds of unlawful activity
- threats, harassment or abusive conduct
- unlawfully infringing another person’s rights
- using another person’s receiving information without authorization
- attempting to compromise Fundu’s security
- manipulating campaign totals or platform functionality
- any other serious misuse of Fundu

Fundu is a fundraising service, not an investment crowdfunding platform. Campaigns must not offer shares, equity, securities, interest, guaranteed financial returns, profit participation, investment contracts or similar investment benefits, unless Fundu later expressly introduces a legally compliant service that permits them.
#### 13. Comments and community conduct

Please communicate respectfully when using community features. You must not use comments or other community features for harassment, threats, spam, scams, deliberately misleading or unlawful content, or publishing another person’s sensitive or private information without appropriate authority.
Fundu may moderate or remove content where reasonably necessary to enforce its rules, protect users or comply with applicable law.
#### 14. Reporting campaigns and misuse

You may report a campaign or activity you reasonably believe involves fraud, impersonation, misleading information, prohibited activity, misuse of receiving information or another breach of Fundu’s rules.
To report a campaign during the beta, email funduhelp@gmail.com with the campaign link and the reason for your concern.
A report does not automatically establish wrongdoing. Fundu may review the available information and take appropriate platform-level action.
#### 15. Moderation, campaign removal and account suspension

Fundu may review, restrict, unpublish or remove campaigns, and may restrict or suspend accounts, where reasonably necessary because of a breach of these Terms, suspected fraud, impersonation, security concerns, unlawful activity, serious misuse, legal requirements, or risks to Fundu or its users.
Where reasonably appropriate, Fundu may ask for additional information before or after taking action.
#### 16. Ending campaigns and closing accounts
Organizers can end a campaign early. An ended campaign remains viewable with its story and updates, but no longer asks for support.

Ending a campaign does not necessarily mean that all account or campaign information is immediately deleted. Account closure, deletion and the retention of personal information are explained in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
#### 17. Third-party services
Fundu relies on third-party services for things such as hosting, infrastructure, sign-in, storage, email and security.

When you use a third-party receiving or payment service to send or receive money, that service may have its own terms and privacy practices. These Terms do not replace the terms that govern third-party services.
#### 18. Privacy
How Fundu handles personal information is described in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
#### 19. Liability and consumer rights

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Fundu is not responsible for losses arising solely from an organizer’s acts or omissions, representations, use of funds, or direct transactions between organizers and supporters.
Fundu does not guarantee that a campaign will achieve its goal or that every statement made by an organizer is accurate.

Nothing in these Terms excludes, restricts or limits any liability, remedy or consumer right that cannot lawfully be excluded, restricted or limited. Nothing in these Terms limits any rights or remedies available to you that cannot lawfully be excluded or restricted under applicable consumer-protection law.
#### 20. Changes to these Terms
Fundu may update these Terms as the service, legal requirements, security requirements or operational requirements change. This page always shows the current “Last updated” date.
Where a change materially affects your rights or obligations, Fundu may give reasonable notice where appropriate and ask for renewed acceptance where required.
#### 21. Governing law and disputes
These Terms and your use of Fundu are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
If a dispute arises, you and Fundu should first try in good faith to resolve it directly.

Nothing in these Terms prevents you from exercising rights available under applicable Nigerian law, making a complaint to an appropriate regulator, or bringing a matter before a court of competent jurisdiction. Where appropriate, you may also be able to make a consumer complaint to the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission.
#### 22. Contact
- **Fundu support:** funduhelp@gmail.com
- **Legal notices:** funduhelp@gmail.com
- **Privacy:** funduhelp@gmail.com
- **Operating entity:** Fundu
privacy: **Last updated:** 28 September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what personal information Fundu collects, why we use it, when it may be shared, what may be visible to other people, how long information may be kept, and the choices and rights available to you. It applies to Fundu’s website, accounts, campaigns and related services.
- **Operator and data controller:** Fundu
- **Privacy contact:** funduhelp@gmail.com
#### The short version (summary box)

- **Public campaign information:** title, story, photos and videos; fundraising goal and organizer-reported amount raised; organizer identity and profile shown on the campaign; updates and comments; receiving information selected for the campaign.
- **Account information:** sign-in details, unpublished drafts and account settings. Not displayed publicly just because you have an account.
- **Private (unlisted) campaigns** aren’t shown in public discovery, but anyone who has the link may view and share them. Private does not mean confidential.
This summary is provided to make this Policy easier to understand. The complete Privacy Policy below explains Fundu’s data practices.
#### 1. Information we collect
##### A. Account and profile information
Depending on how you use Fundu, this may include your name, email address, display name, profile photo, country, bio and account settings.
If you sign in with an authentication provider such as Google, Fundu may receive information made available through that sign-in, such as your name, email address and profile image.
##### B. Campaign information

This may include the campaign title, category, fundraising goal, campaign dates, story, images, videos, updates, beneficiary information you provide, organizer-reported fundraising totals, and the campaign’s privacy and discovery settings.
##### C. Receiving and payment information

Fundu may collect the information needed to set up supported receiving methods. Depending on the method, this may include the country, provider or bank name, account holder name, account number, registered mobile number, wallet or payment identifier, payment link, or other information the method requires.

Receiving information you select for a campaign may be displayed to people who can view that campaign, so they can support you directly. Fundu does not need your banking password, mobile-money PIN, wallet password, card PIN or one-time code to display receiving information.
##### D. Comments and activity
This may include comments, campaign updates, publishing activity, changes to organizer-reported amounts, and other account and campaign activity that Fundu records.
##### E. Technical and security information

When you use Fundu, our systems and service providers may record technical information needed to run and secure the service, such as sign-in and security events, login times, and information about your browser or device.
##### F. Support communications
If you contact Fundu, we process your message, contact details, anything you choose to include, and relevant support history, so we can respond to and manage your request.
#### 2. How we use personal information
Where applicable, Fundu uses personal information to:
- create and manage accounts, and authenticate users
- create, host, publish and display campaigns
- display the receiving information organizers select
- let campaigns be shared
- provide comments and updates, and keep a record of account and campaign activity
- provide customer support
- maintain security, and prevent and investigate fraud and abuse
- enforce Fundu’s rules
- troubleshoot, operate and improve Fundu
- comply with applicable legal obligations
#### 3. Lawful basis for processing
Fundu processes personal information only where there is an appropriate lawful basis under applicable data-protection law, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
##### Contractual necessity
Where processing is necessary to create and manage your account, authenticate you, create, host and publish campaigns, manage receiving methods, and provide the Fundu services you ask for.
##### Legitimate interests
For platform security, fraud and abuse prevention, protecting users, troubleshooting and improving Fundu, where our interests are not overridden by your rights and freedoms.
##### Legal obligation
Where Fundu must process information to comply with applicable law or lawful requirements.
##### Consent

Where Fundu specifically asks for your consent for optional processing for which consent is appropriate, such as certain marketing or non-essential tracking. Consent is not the basis for all processing.
#### 4. What other people can see

For a published campaign, viewers may see the information intentionally displayed on it, which may include the title, story, images and videos, goal, organizer-reported amount raised, organizer identity and profile information, updates, comments, and the receiving information selected for that campaign.

Public campaigns may appear in Explore or other public discovery surfaces. Private (unlisted) campaigns don’t appear in public discovery, but may be accessed by anyone with the link. **Private or unlisted does not mean confidential.**

Email addresses, passwords, unpublished drafts and private account settings are not intentionally displayed on campaign pages, unless you choose to include particular information in your campaign content.
#### 5. Receiving information and privacy
To let supporters send money directly to organizers, Fundu may display the receiving information an organizer selects for a campaign. The exact information displayed depends on the receiving method.

Only add or select receiving information you are comfortable sharing with the campaign’s intended audience. Fundu will show which receiving information will become visible before you select or publish it.
Receiving information that is intentionally displayed on a campaign is not confidential.
#### 6. Service providers and data sharing

Fundu uses third-party service providers to operate the platform, including Supabase for authentication, database and file storage, Vercel for website hosting, Formspree for Help form messages, and Google where you choose Google Sign-In. Where reasonably necessary to operate Fundu, personal information may be processed by these providers on our behalf.

Fundu may also disclose information where reasonably necessary and legally permitted to comply with applicable law, respond to lawful legal processes, protect Fundu and its users, investigate fraud or security incidents, and enforce our [Terms of Service](/terms).
**Fundu does not sell your personal information.**
#### 7. International data transfers

Fundu may use service providers that process personal information outside Nigeria. Where personal information is transferred across borders, Fundu will take the steps required by applicable data-protection law to ensure the transfer has a lawful basis and appropriate safeguards.
#### 8. Cookies and similar technologies
Fundu uses essential cookies and similar browser storage to keep you signed in and to keep your session secure. These are needed for Fundu to work.
Fundu does not currently set its own analytics or advertising cookies. If that changes, this policy will be updated and, where required, we will ask for your consent.

**Embedded content.** Campaigns may contain content embedded from third-party services, such as video providers. When you load or interact with embedded content, the third-party provider may receive technical information about your device or interaction and may use cookies or similar technologies under its own privacy policy. These technologies are controlled by the relevant third party rather than Fundu.
#### 9. Data retention

Fundu retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy, including providing the service, maintaining security, resolving disputes, enforcing agreements and meeting legal obligations.

Retention periods may vary according to the type of information and the reason it is processed. When personal information is no longer reasonably required, Fundu will delete, anonymize or securely dispose of it, subject to any lawful retention requirement.
#### 10. Account closure and deletion
- **Ending a campaign** stops it asking for support. Its story and updates remain viewable.
- **Deleting a campaign** removes it from Fundu and makes its link unavailable.
- **Closing your account** can be requested at funduhelp@gmail.com, or done from Settings where that option is available.

When an account or campaign is deleted, Fundu may retain some information where reasonably necessary for legal obligations, security, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, enforcing agreements or other lawful purposes. Other personal information will be deleted or anonymized in line with section 9.
#### 11. Your privacy rights
Subject to applicable law and the circumstances, you may have rights over your personal information, including the right to:
- be informed about how it is used
- access it
- correct inaccurate information
- request deletion (erasure)
- restrict certain processing
- object to certain processing
- withdraw consent where processing relies on consent
- data portability, where applicable
- protections relating to qualifying automated decision-making
- lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission

Not every request requires Fundu to delete every record, for example where the law requires us to keep it. Fundu may need to verify your identity before acting on a request, where reasonably necessary.
#### 12. Security

Fundu uses reasonable technical and organizational measures intended to protect personal information. No system can be completely secure, and you are responsible for protecting your own sign-in details.
Fundu will never ask you to provide your bank password, mobile-money PIN, wallet password, card PIN or one-time verification code merely to display a receiving method.
#### 13. Children

Fundu accounts and organizer features are intended for people aged 18 and over. People under 18 may be beneficiaries of campaigns created and managed by eligible adults. Fundu does not knowingly allow a person under 18 to create an organizer account.
If Fundu becomes aware that personal information about a child has been collected or processed contrary to applicable requirements, Fundu will take appropriate steps consistent with applicable law.
#### 14. Changes to this Privacy Policy

Fundu may update this Policy as its services, data practices, legal requirements or operational requirements change. This page always shows the current “Last updated” date. Where a change materially affects you, Fundu may give additional notice where appropriate or required.
#### 15. Contact and privacy complaints
Contact us with privacy questions, requests to access, correct or delete your information, or other privacy concerns.
- **Privacy contact:** funduhelp@gmail.com
- **Operator and data controller:** Fundu
You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.
